plan: Given my value is $0, I will bid $0. Any positive bid would result in a loss if I win, as I would pay the second-highest bid without any value gain. This minimizes potential loss.

Given my value of $43, I will bid slightly below it to ensure profit if I win. I estimate others will bid near their values. To win, I'll bid $42, expecting others to bid lower, maximizing my potential profit.

Given my low value of $5, I will bid conservatively to avoid overpaying. I expect others to bid close to their values, which are likely higher. I'll bid $3 to minimize loss while allowing a chance to win if others bid low.
